title: Harnessing nanomedicine to target NF-kappaB signalling in cancer: at the intersection of inflammatory signalling, metabolic reprogramming, and therapeutic innovation.
authors: BharathwajChetty, Bandari; Aswani, Babu Santha; Shinde, Shweta S; Alqahtani, Mohammed S; Abbas, Mohamed; Sethi, Gautam; Ma, Zhaowu; Kunnumakkara, Ajaikumar B
one_liner_zh: 该文综述纳米医学靶向NF-kappaB信号通路用于癌症治疗，聚焦炎症与代谢重编程，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) signalling pathway is a pivotal orchestrator of inflammation, tumour progression, immune modulation, and metabolic reprogramming within the dynamic landscape of the tumour microenvironment (TME). Aberrant and sustained activation of NF-kappaB is frequently associated with tumour proliferation, resistance to therapy, and poor clinical outcomes. However, conventional NF-kappaB inhibitors face significant limitations, including systemic toxicity, poor bioavailability, and lack of tumour specificity. Nanomedicine offers a transformative approach to overcome these barriers by enabling the targeted delivery of NF-kappaB modulators, such as small molecules, RNA interference agents, and gene-editing systems, directly to tumour sites. Recent advances in nanocarriers, including liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, exosomes, and dendrimers, have demonstrated improved therapeutic indices, enhanced stability, and reduced off-target effects. This review highlights the convergence of nanotechnology, inflammatory signalling, and cancer metabolism, with a focus on how nanomedicine can precisely modulate NF-kappaB signalling to reprogramme tumour-associated macrophages and remodel the TME. It also discusses preclinical evidence supporting NF-kappaB-targeted nanomedicine, innovative delivery strategies, and the translational challenges that impede clinical adoption. Collectively, these insights highlight the potential of nanomedicine in advancing NF-kappaB-targeted cancer therapy by enhancing drug specificity, safety, and therapeutic responsiveness. Future developments integrating artificial intelligence, theranostic design, and personalised nanomedicine are expected to accelerate clinical translation and establish NF-kappaB-targeted nanotherapeutics as a cornerstone of next-generation precision oncology.Graphical Abstract
abstract_zh: 核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）信号通路在肿瘤微环境（TME）的动态格局中，是炎症、肿瘤进展、免疫调节和代谢重编程的关键协调者。NF-kappaB的异常且持续激活常与肿瘤增殖、治疗耐药及不良临床结局相关。然而，传统NF-kappaB抑制剂面临显著局限性，包括全身毒性、生物利用度低以及缺乏肿瘤特异性。纳米医学通过实现NF-kappaB调节剂（如小分子、RNA干扰剂和基因编辑系统）直接靶向递送至肿瘤部位，提供了一种变革性方法来克服这些障碍。纳米载体（包括脂质体、聚合物纳米颗粒、外泌体和树枝状大分子）的最新进展已显示出改善的治疗指数、增强的稳定性以及减少的脱靶效应。本综述重点探讨纳米技术、炎症信号传导和癌症代谢的交叉融合，聚焦于纳米医学如何精确调节NF-kappaB信号以重编程肿瘤相关巨噬细胞并重塑TME。它还讨论了支持NF-kappaB靶向纳米医学的临床前证据、创新递送策略，以及阻碍临床转化的转化挑战。总体而言，这些见解凸显了纳米医学通过增强药物特异性、安全性和治疗反应性，在推进NF-kappaB靶向癌症治疗中的潜力。未来整合人工智能、诊疗一体化设计和个性化纳米医学的发展，预计将加速临床转化，并使NF-kappaB靶向纳米治疗成为下一代精准肿瘤学的基石。图形摘要
